name: the once and future lord of nothing
source:
A surrealist 90s shoujo inspired black and white visual novel about being mentally ill in the yakuza. 

[Edited from [url=https://swanchime.itch.io/the-once-and-future-lord-of-nothing]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一部從90年代少女漫畫中汲取靈感的超現實主義黑白視覺小說，講述身在日本黑道、又患有精神疾病是怎樣的體驗。

［改寫自[url=https://swanchime.itch.io/the-once-and-future-lord-of-nothing]itch.io[/url]］
